setup.intro: AI isn't available yet. Pick one of these.

ask.title: Set it up once for this server
ask.body: Set this up once and everyone on this server can use AI as they are. If you can't set it up yourself, copy the request below and send it to whoever can.
ask.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Send the text below, as it is, to whoever can set it up.
ask.template: Please enable AI in Asterism. Under Settings → “This server” → “Shared AI setup”, register a key from an AI service once, and everyone using this server will be able to use AI.

own.title: Paste your own key
own.body: Paste the string your AI service gave you. We work out which service it belongs to.
own.placeholder: Paste the key you were given
own.basePlaceholder: The service's address (as given to you)
own.noModels: No AI was found at that address. Check the address.
own.failed: That didn't work. Check what you pasted and the address.
own.pickModel: This endpoint offers more than one AI. Choose the one to use.

local.title: Use the AI on this computer
local.body: If you're running an AI on this computer, you can use it as it is.
local.use: Use the AI on this computer
local.failed: No AI was found on this computer.

setup.advancedHint: To register a connection and name it yourself,

models.intro: Register where AI runs. If it's already set up on the server, there is nothing to do here. To use your own key or an AI on your machine, add it with “+ Add” — the one you pick is used by “Add data”, “Ask” and every other AI feature.
models.empty: No AI connection yet. To use your own key, press “+ Add”.
models.serverConfigured: AI is already set up on this server ({{provider}}). You can use AI without adding anything here.
models.keyServer: using the server's setup (no key needed)

form.endpointReuseHelp: Uses this connection's provider, endpoint and API key as they are — nothing to retype.
form.name: Display name
form.maxTokensHelp: Defaults to 96000 when unset. Models with a small context window (qwen3 etc.) need 16000–32000.
form.apiKeyServerHint: This provider has a server-side default key — leave blank to use it.
form.rememberOn: The key is saved in localStorage and persists across reloads and restarts.
form.rememberOff: The key stays in sessionStorage only — cleared when the tab closes (never written to disk).
form.rateHelp: Input/output price per 1M tokens. Set it to estimate cost (without it, tokens are still tracked but cost shows “—”). There's no pricing API to auto-fetch current prices — check the provider's pricing page (JPY is fine).
form.cacheNote: Cache prices are derived from the input price (Anthropic: read 0.1×, write 1.25×; the OpenAI-compatible path uses no caching).

usage.placeholder: The usage dashboard ships in Phase C.
usage.intro: The server records the tokens used by each AI call; this tab aggregates them and estimates cost from your model rate table at display time.
usage.empty: Nothing recorded yet. Using AI in “Add data” or “Ask” shows up here.
usage.error: Couldn't load usage. Wait a moment and press “Reload”.
usage.unratedNote: Note: usage on models without a configured rate ({{tokens}} tokens) is NOT included in the estimated cost. Set a rate in the model editor to include it.

gate.notSetUp: The AI is not connected yet. Once one is set up on the server, this screen works as it is. To use your own, connect it in one screen below.

serverKeys.title: Shared AI setup
serverKeys.intro: Set this up and everyone using this server can use AI without bringing anything of their own. It only needs to be set up once. What you enter is never shown back.
serverKeys.keyPlaceholder: Paste the key you were given
serverKeys.basePlaceholder: The service's address (as given to you)
serverKeys.clearWarning: Clearing this stops AI for everyone using this server. Restoring it means entering the key again.

error.auth: You don't have permission to save this. Enter the access code first, then try again.
error.disabled: This server doesn't allow the shared AI setup to be saved.
error.badBase: This server won't accept that address. Check the address.
error.generic: Couldn't save. Wait a moment and try again.

writeToken.title: Access code (for this server)
writeToken.intro: To add data or publish on this server you need this server's access code. Paste it here and it stays valid until you close this tab.
writeToken.name: Access code

check.ok: This code lets you add data and publish
check.mismatch: That code is wrong. Check it and try again
check.open: No access code is set up on this server (check the server's setup)
check.error: Couldn't reach the server. Wait a moment and try again

about.title: App info
about.autoCheckNote: Checked automatically at startup and every 24 hours; when an update is out, a notice appears at the top of the window. You can also check manually here.
about.webNote: Update checks are for the desktop app (in the browser, whatever the server serves is already current).
about.availableBanner: Version {{version}} is available — update from the notice at the top of the window.
about.installHint: Updates are installed by the desktop app itself (the notice at the top of the app window, or Asterism → “アップデートを確認…” (Check for Updates…) in the menu bar; the app downloads and installs it, verifying the signature).
about.checkFailed: Update check failed. Check your network and try again.

instance.title: Where your IDs are issued from
instance.intro: New datasets issue their IDs under this address (existing data is never rewritten). It's set once for the whole server.
instance.name: Issuer address
instance.unsetHelp: No issuer has been chosen yet, so IDs are made under the placeholder address above. That is fine while you try things out. For IDs that stay citable after you publish, set the issuer address on the server (for example https://data.your-org.ac.jp/).

storage.title: Local storage location
storage.intro: The folder where datasets, graphs, chats, and settings are stored.
storage.browserNote: This cannot be changed from this view (viewed in a browser). Change it from the desktop app window instead.
storage.restartPending: {{path}} will be used starting from the next launch. Restart Asterism to apply it.
storage.syncWarning: The location you chose looks like a sync folder. The graph store (Oxigraph) is binary data that does not get along well with sync tools, and opening it from multiple devices at once can corrupt it.
storage.migrateNote: Existing data is not moved automatically. If you want to keep it, quit Asterism first, then manually copy the contents of the old folder into the new one.
